name: What The Diff
tagline: Writes PR descriptions from the diff, sends changelog notifications to stakeholders, and does small /wtd refactors on GitHub and GitLab.
pricing: Free: 25,000 tokens/mo (~10 PRs); Pro $19/mo: 200,000 tokens (~40 PRs). Token-metered (avg PR ~2,300 tokens); no rollover
modelControl: Fixed vendor model; no BYOK or model choice documented

01-multi-dimensional-context.note: Explicitly diff-only: analyzes the PR diff to write a description; not a bug-finding reviewer.

02-rule-centric.note: No custom rules or noise controls documented.

03-dual-workflow.note: PR surface only; no IDE, CLI, or pre-commit mode.

05-continuous-learning.note: No learning from developer feedback documented.

06-sandbox-validation.note: No code execution or test running documented.

07-economic-transparency.note: No BYOK, but usage is metered in visible tokens with published per-PR averages (~2,300 tokens/PR).

08-actionability.note: On-demand /wtd comments produce small refactor suggestions in the PR; no review-driven fixes.

09-measurable-roi.note: Weekly progress report notifications only; no acceptance, DORA, or cost dashboards.
